entry.name: jit.gl.pass
entry.digest: Render scene passes with shader processing
entry.description: The jit.gl.pass object encapsulates processing of one or more sub-passes. A sub-pass consists of a single frame of gl, and post-processing shader, and is defined in a xml pass description file (JXP). Complex scene-processing hierarchies can be obtained by chaining multiple jit.gl.pass objects.
